entities.summary: Nicholas Charnetsky, Mykolai Charnetskyi or Mykolay Charnetsky also known as Nicholas of Volyn ( was a member of the Redemptorists, a religious congregation in the Byzantine Rite of the Catholic Church; he is considered a martyr by the church.
